name: How long does it take to build a custom home?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to build a custom home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for building a custom home varies significantly based on factors such as the home's size, complexity of design, site conditions, permit approval times, and material availability. On average, a custom home can take anywhere from 10 to 18 months from initial design to move-in. This includes several months for design and permitting, followed by 6-12 months for construction. We provide a detailed project schedule early in the process so you have clear expectations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom home construction typically takes 10 to 18 months, depending on design complexity, size, site conditions, and permit approvals.
